verdict.rationale: Ultrametric installs skill files (SKILL.md for Codex and Claude Code), and `init --dry-run` previews which files will be created. However, nothing in the evidence shows that each skill documents what it does or when it activates. The dry-run is a related control that previews file writes, not documentation of the agent's resulting behavior or activation triggers, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, every skill documents what it does and when it activates, so I can predict my agent's new behavior before it surprises me
